name: Telecommunications
description: CDR/usage, network telemetry, billing, churn and subscriber analytics
rules: Usage/CDR pipelines must be exactly-once or reconcile duplicates before billing
Subscriber PII and location data subject to telecom retention laws
Network KPIs published only after late-window CDR catch-up
Billing mediation rejects negative or impossible usage without ops review
memories: Roaming settlement files are T+1 and multi-currency — FX tables versioned by day
5G telemetry volumes require partitioned lakehouse tables by cell/region
